prompt: Turn this list into a balanced recommendation for a neighborhood reading room: 'Open late twice a week. Quiet corner needed. A noticeboard might help. Too few volunteers for every evening. Trial for one month before deciding.' Please answer in roughly 80 words.
text: Recommend a one-month trial for the neighborhood reading room, opening late on two evenings each week rather than attempting daily extended hours. Reserve a clearly marked quiet corner for focused reading, and add a noticeboard for local updates, events, and volunteer sign-ups. This approach responds to demand while recognising that volunteer capacity is limited. At the end of the month, gather feedback on attendance, atmosphere, and staffing before deciding whether to continue or adjust the arrangement.
